{"items":[{"ref":"R03","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段页的等待状态适用性","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"当前画面已完整呈现选择项及核对按钮，是普通选择状态，不是加载或处理中状态；此范围不含后续操作。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","2d7a58bb42e684a5f467b15e"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R03","coverage_id":"coverage-00985e7c4fe62894","coverage_title":"BR02提交过程中可能出现的等待说明","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"提交过程尚无观察，不能确认是否存在等待状态；若出现，再检查处理对象及进度说明。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["提交动作及前后状态","若出现等待，取得完整等待区域及观察时长"],"object_refs":["TASK03","BR02"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ03"],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R04","coverage_id":"coverage-00985e7c4fe62894","coverage_title":"BR02登记完成页的结果表达","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"任务要求查看完成结果，但尚未取得完成状态；需确认结果能关联最终登记的时段和服务台。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["最终核对内容及提交动作记录","完整完成页与结果文案"],"object_refs":["TASK03","BR02"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ03"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R05","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段页关键文案的用户熟悉度","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"关键选择文案可见，但目标用户、专业程度及熟悉度未知，不能凭日常用词或控件内部名称推断理解障碍。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e","ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["目标用户与专业程度依据","如有疑似内部术语，补充含义、任务必要性及熟悉度依据"],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","选择时段及服务台文案"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d"],"constraint_refs":["REQ01"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","statement"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段页“核对信息”的预期动作","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"applicable","reason":"当前有“核对信息”主按钮，任务明确要求选择后进入核对，可结合邻近选择内容检查名称是否说明预期结果。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e","ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["[data-review-control=\"2\"]","核对信息"],"object_ids":["obj-9a05df3aa32e6dbc9354"],"constraint_refs":["REQ01"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","requirement"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"coverage-ed287ed6ebf0b7a9","coverage_title":"BR01核对页“返回选择”的动作命名","task_id":"TASK02","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"材料明确返回选择的动作目的，但核对页尚未呈现，需取得实际入口及邻近说明后检查。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["核对页完整画面及返回入口文案"],"object_refs":["TASK02","BR01","返回选择"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ02"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","requirement"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"coverage-00985e7c4fe62894","coverage_title":"BR02登记提交入口的动作命名","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"提交目的已知，但实际提交入口及上下文未提供，不能假定按钮名称或清晰程度。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["提交入口及邻近核对说明"],"object_refs":["TASK03","BR02"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ03"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","requirement"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"coverage-69570b8a3c19099f","coverage_title":"BR03完成页“重新开始”的动作命名","task_id":"TASK04","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"材料说明重新开始用于复位，但尚无完成页入口画面；名称检查与实际复位验证分开。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["完成页重新开始入口及邻近说明"],"object_refs":["TASK04","BR03","重新开始"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ04"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","requirement"]},{"ref":"R07","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段输入项的名称与说明","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"applicable","reason":"时段单选项是任务必需的表单输入，需核对可见名称与服务台对应关系；DOM回退名称slot不等同于可见标签缺失。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e","ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["更换为下午选项后的画面，用于检查名称是否持续可见"],"object_refs":["[data-review-control=\"0\"]","[data-review-control=\"1\"]","周五09:00–09:30／一层服务台","周五14:00–14:30／二层服务台"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d","obj-9d4c6232b835f7c92702"],"constraint_refs":["REQ01"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation"]},{"ref":"R08","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段页的弹窗适用性","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"当前完整画面呈现页面内登记表单，不是占据焦点的弹窗；仅限该已取得状态，不推断后续是否有弹窗。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","2d7a58bb42e684a5f467b15e"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择时段首步的返回入口适用性","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"画面明确标注“第1步，共3步”，符合首步排除条件，不能要求该页提供上一步入口。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","2d7a58bb42e684a5f467b15e"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"coverage-ed287ed6ebf0b7a9","coverage_title":"BR01核对页的可见返回入口","task_id":"TASK02","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务卡明确核对页位于选择之后且需返回选择；检查入口可见性，返回后保留数据另按REQ02验证。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["核对页完整画面及页面返回入口","若页面无返回入口，补充可观察系统导航及其作用范围"],"object_refs":["TASK02","BR01","返回选择"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ02"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design"]},{"ref":"R10","coverage_id":"coverage-00985e7c4fe62894","coverage_title":"BR02本机演示登记的高风险确认适用性","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"材料明确登记仅在本机当前页面生效且可复位；本任务为普通演示登记，不属于删除、清空或永久变更等高风险确认。","source_ids":["src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["TASK03","BR02"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement"]}]}
